from pathlib import Path
import re,json,hashlib,subprocess,collections
R=Path('/Users/wkoch/Projetos/xrai');base='bd12a9a';log='docs/relatorios/logs/revisao-L5-C06-fechamento/'
md=['IMPLEMENTADOR.md','README.md','docs/L5-PROXIMA-EXECUCAO.md','docs/PLANO-DE-IMPLEMENTACAO.md','docs/PLANO-DE-VALIDACAO.md','docs/ROTEIRO-V1.md','docs/STATUS-IMPLEMENTACAO.md','docs/relatorios/REVISAO-L5-C06.md','docs/relatorios/REVISAO-L5-C06-FECHAMENTO.md']
owned=md+[log+n for n in ['evidencias.json','agentes.json','documentacao.json']]
def old(p):return subprocess.check_output(['git','show',base+':'+p],cwd=R,text=True)
def cur(p):return (R/p).read_text()
def sha(b):return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def rows(s):return re.findall(r'^\| (M[01]-[^|]+) \| ([^|]+) \| ([^|]+) \|',s,re.M)
s='docs/STATUS-IMPLEMENTACAO.md';assert rows(old(s))==rows(cur(s)) and len(rows(cur(s)))==41
counts=dict(collections.Counter(r[2].strip() for r in rows(cur(s))));assert counts=={'concluída':9,'em andamento':7,'não iniciada':25}
p='docs/PLANO-DE-IMPLEMENTACAO.md';pattern=r'^### (M[01]-[^\n]+)\n\n(\*\*Depende de:\*\*[^\n]+)';assert re.findall(pattern,old(p),re.M)==re.findall(pattern,cur(p),re.M);assert len(re.findall(pattern,cur(p),re.M))==41
v='docs/ROTEIRO-V1.md';pattern=r'### V1-.*?(?=\n### V1-|\n## 5\.)';assert re.findall(pattern,old(v),re.S)==re.findall(pattern,cur(v),re.S);assert len(re.findall(pattern,cur(v),re.S))==6
assert re.findall(r'^\| G[012] \|.*$',old(s),re.M)==re.findall(r'^\| G[012] \|.*$',cur(s),re.M)
links=[]
for n in md:
 for link in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',cur(n)):
  if re.match(r'(https?://|mailto:|#)',link):continue
  target=link.split('#',1)[0];p=(R/n).parent/target
  assert p.exists() or p.resolve()==(R/log/'documentacao.json').resolve(),(n,link)
  links.append([n,link])
root=json.loads((R/log/'evidencias.json').read_text());assert all(sha((R/n).read_bytes())==h for n,h in root['source_sha256'].items())
a=json.loads((R/log/'agentes.json').read_text())
for agent in a['agents'].values():
 e=agent['evidence']
 for n,h in e.get('before',{}).items():assert sha(subprocess.check_output(['git','show',base+':'+n],cwd=R))==h
 for row in e.get('inputs_final_snapshot',[]):
  if not row['path'].startswith('/'):
   assert sha(subprocess.check_output(['git','show',base+':'+row['path']],cwd=R))==row['sha256']
 assert sha(agent['report'].encode())==agent['report_sha256']
# Recheck historical verifier after architectural plan changed, without re-running unrelated suites.
h=subprocess.run(['python3','-B','eval/adapters/historical-v1/verify.py'],cwd=R,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
hist=json.loads(h.stdout);assert hist['verified'] and hist['current_plan_sha256']==sha((R/'docs/PLANO-DE-IMPLEMENTACAO.md').read_bytes()) and not hist['current_plan_binding_claimed']
subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check','--',*owned],cwd=R,check=True)
changed=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only'],cwd=R,text=True).splitlines();untracked=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'],cwd=R,text=True).splitlines()
foreign=sorted((set(changed)|set(untracked))-set(owned))
result={'schema':'xrai.architecture.c06.closure-doc-check.v1','verified':True,'base':base,'cards_preserved':41,'status_counts':counts,'six_v1_full_blocks_unchanged':True,'gates_unchanged':True,'local_links':len(links),'local_links_valid':True,'current_source_hashes_match_review':True,'agent_review_hashes_match_base':True,'historical_verifier_after_plan_update':{'verified':hist['verified'],'current_plan_sha256':hist['current_plan_sha256'],'capsule_members':hist['capsule_members'],'current_plan_binding_claimed':False},'owned_paths':owned,'foreign_changes_excluded':foreign,'file_sha256':{n:sha((R/n).read_bytes()) for n in owned if n!=log+'documentacao.json'},'verification_recipe':Path(__file__).read_text()}
(R/log/'documentacao.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
Path('/tmp/xrai-c06-close-owned.json').write_text(json.dumps(owned))
print(json.dumps({k:result[k] for k in ['verified','cards_preserved','status_counts','local_links','foreign_changes_excluded']}))
